description: This file defines functions and constants for handling different versions of Kickstart syntax, including version mapping, conversion, and dynamic class loading based on version identifiers.

methods.name: stringToVersion
methods.description: Converts a version string to a symbolic constant, raising an error if unsupported.

methods.name: versionToString
methods.description: Converts a version constant to its string representation.

methods.name: versionToLongString
methods.description: Converts a version constant to a descriptive long string.

methods.name: versionFromFile
methods.description: Reads a file to determine the Kickstart version from a comment line.

methods.name: returnClassForVersion
methods.description: Dynamically loads and returns the handler class for a given version.

methods.name: makeVersion
methods.description: Instantiates and returns a handler object for a specified version.

methods.name: getVersionFromCommandClass
methods.description: Extracts version number from a class name.

methods.name: isRHEL
methods.description: Checks if a version corresponds to RHEL.
